titel: Shopping around Venray: Venlo and Roermond | Hotel Asteria
omschrijving: Shopping and towns from Hotel Asteria: Venray town centre in six minutes, Venlo on the Maas and Designer Outlet Roermond as a day trip.
hero-sub: Shops and terraces in Venray, a town on the Maas in Venlo and a day at the outlet in Roermond.

intro-kop: From the Grote Markt to the Maas
intro-tekst: Venray town centre is six minutes' drive away: shops, terraces and a weekly market every Monday. Venlo is about 25 minutes away, with an old town centre on the Maas. Designer Outlet Roermond is forty minutes by car; plan a whole day for it.

f1-v: How far is Venray town centre?
f1-a: Six minutes by car. By bike it takes about twenty minutes.
f2-v: When is the weekly market in Venray?
f2-a: Every Monday from 11 am to 4 pm on the Henseniusplein and the Schouwburgplein.
f3-v: Are the shops in Venray open on Sundays?
f3-a: Only on a few Sunday shopping days a year. You'll find the dates on the website of the municipality or the shopping area.
f4-v: How far is Designer Outlet Roermond?
f4-a: About forty minutes by car. Plan a whole day.
f5-a: Yes, there are car parks near the centre. Reception will show you the way.
f6-v: Can I leave my shopping at the hotel?
f6-a: Of course, your room is your base. Feel free to ask about the options when you arrive or after check-out.
